plugins.name: optiflow
plugins.description: Orchestrator plugin: chop-style Bash interception, transcript analytics, statusline context meter, compact-continue handoff, and TOON conversion. Wires token-optimizer-mcp and headroom together via plugin/.mcp.json (pinned npx package + optional headroom binary on PATH) rather than registering them as separate marketplace plugins.
